text.source: Results: unofficial county returns from the Michigan Secretary of State (mvic.sos.state.mi.us), updated Nov 6, 2026 1:25 PM ET, with all 83 counties reporting. These are unofficial and counts may change until the state canvass is certified. Third-party candidates (Libertarian Anthony Hudson 0.9%, U.S. Taxpayers Donna Brandenburg 0.4%, Green Douglas Campbell 0.4%) and write-ins are not shown. Swing compares with the official 2022 governor county results from the Michigan Secretary of State (two-party share). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025).
